newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian VP said planning evening programme.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian VP said planning evening programme.

text.p: Indonesian Vice-President Try Sutrisno was scheduled to attend a fast-breaking meal with senior government officials later on Tuesday, an official from the vice-president's office said.
"He's fine. He has no official programme today but later in the evening will attend a fast breaking meal with senior government officials," the official, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.
A rumour that Sutrisno had died swept the Jakarta stock exchange late on Tuesday.
"The rumour has prompted further profit-taking in late trading," one local broker said.
Money market traders said the rumour appeared to have no affect on the foreign exchange markets.
